purpose: Audits a vault curator's point-in-time allocation snapshot against per-market caps and a declared mandate from caller-declared minor-unit values only. Caps follow the pinned Morpho curation documentation semantics: an absolute cap is a fixed maximum amount per market and a relative cap is a maximum share of the vault's total assets, compared by exact integer cross-multiplication with no division; caps are allocation-time constraints, so an audit legitimately reports observed breaches on a snapshot. Also checks the declared mandate (per-market, per-asset-class, idle floor, RWA floor, DeFi ceiling), concentration (largest market share and Herfindahl index in basis points), idle-plus-withdrawable coverage of pending redemptions, and conservation (idle plus allocations equals total assets). Verdicts: WITHIN_MANDATE, WITHIN_MANDATE_WITH_WARNINGS or BREACH.
control_description: Values-only mandate-evidence control over a declared curator allocation snapshot: absolute and relative cap breaches per market under the profile's pinned semantics; mandate breaches per market, per asset class, on the idle floor and on RWA-floor / DeFi-ceiling split limits; concentration (largest market share, Herfindahl index in basis points); redemption coverage (idle plus withdrawable against pending, declared horizon); conservation (idle plus allocations equals total assets). Integer minor units and integer basis points throughout; one documented rounding rule (no division — exact integer cross-multiplication, shares floored to integer basis points). No on-chain reads, no pricing; share pricing is the art-610 domain and async redemption state the art-611 domain. No curator or platform is named.
